facts.fact: 去 Candor 总部的路上，Four 在半路超过 Tris，领她上 Grand 站的台阶，一步跨两级。
Tris 认为这场火太巧：听证会在今晚、Mae 在 Candor 总部、而她把地点告诉了 Evelyn。
facts.anchor: When I saw the smoke, all I could think was that it was too coincidental.

facts.fact: Four 一句「你告诉了她」把摩天轮上刚攒起来的那点暖意吹散，他重新变成硬眼神、带着悲愤的那个人。
facts.anchor: The boy who insisted on helping me climb despite his obvious terror, the boy who told me I looked Dauntless, is gone.

facts.fact: Tris 失控爆粗，当面向 Four 否认自己是 Evelyn 的跑腿。
facts.anchor: “For the last time, I am not her goddamn errand girl!”

facts.fact: 列车进站时两人并肩跑，Four 比她快却没有先上车，而是用手推她的背催她先上。
facts.anchor: He’s faster than I am, so I expect him to board before me, but instead I feel the press of his hand against my back, warm and urging me to move.

facts.fact: Tris 担心父亲不会自救：他若能帮别人，就会把机会让出去，这是 Abnegation 虔诚信徒的好处也是坏处。
facts.anchor: The best and worst thing about my father is that he’s a devoted member of Abnegation.

facts.fact: 七层楼上走廊从大理石变成玻璃；玻璃是择派仪式上 Candor 那只碗的材料，Tris 把它和「说真话」连在一起。
facts.anchor: Glass is the material that was in the Candor bowl at the Choosing Ceremony, the material that I associate with truth-telling.

facts.fact: 扩音器宣布防火隔离程序一分钟后生效，随后玻璃落下变成金属墙，把两人关在里面。
facts.anchor: I hear a slam behind me, and turn to see a metal wall where there was glass just a moment ago.
